title: Constraint: Interleaved Sorted Arrays
constraints: `a[0] < b[0] < a[1] < b[1] < … < a[5] < b[5]`: both arrays ascending, and each b element lies between consecutive a elements.
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Two chained inequalities per index are enough.
Both arrays are then automatically sorted. You don't need separate sorting constraints.
